::: {.why}
You now have a procedure and a null; measuring the false positive rate of your own pipeline before running it on real data is the discipline this whole course is built around.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Report the empirical false positive rate of your cointegration screen on independent random walks, at a nominal 5 percent.
- Say what the rate becomes when you screen 200 pairs and keep only the best, and state the correction that implies.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Run your day 78 procedure over the 200 independent random walk pairs and report the rejection rate at 5 percent. Then compute the probability that at least one of 200 independent tests rejects, and compare against what you observed.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Do the version that matters: from a universe of 50 real names, screen all 1,225 pairs, and record how many pass. Then run the identical screen on 50 synthetic series from qlib.simulate that have the right stylized facts and no true relationships, and record how many pass there. The second number is the one that goes into the milestone.
:::
:::
